snippet.title: JOIN US - Official XBOX Reveal and Date Announce | XBOX Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
JOIN US March 2027 - Wishlist Today

Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

JOIN US is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass.
